title: A couple gave their US university $20 million. It became a college named for them - built entirely around AI.

sources.text: UNT News - UNT receives $20 million gift to advance artificial intelligence, advanced analytics
Dallas Innovates - UNT to Launch $20M Sinha College of AI and Advanced Analytics

caption:
A couple gave their US university $20 million. It became a college named for them - built entirely around AI.

The gift, announced September 9, 2026, established the Anuradha and Vikas Sinha College of Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Analytics - funding six permanent endowments spanning leadership, scholarships, endowed professorships, entrepreneurship incubation and research.

Vikas Sinha came to the US from India to study civil engineering, later earning a PhD in data science from UNT in 2023. Earlier gifts had already created the university's Department of Data Science and its Sinha Innovation Lab - this one turned a department into an entire college.

The Sinhas didn't just donate money once - they kept building on the same institution, turning a single gift into a growing academic hub for the field India's own workforce will need most.
